PNS.what: Peripheral Nervous System — sensory + motor nerves

dorsal_root.name: AFFERENT — sensory nerves (incoming, toward brain)
dorsal_root.chipmunk: The neutrino observer. Reads membrane. Paints SVG. DORSAL = feels.
dorsal_root.mushroom_ear: Listens to incoming requests, RSS, OSINT. DORSAL = hears.
dorsal_root.membrane_pulse: HTTP requests hitting the membrane surface. DORSAL = touch.

ventral_root.name: EFFERENT — motor nerves (outgoing, from brain)
ventral_root.squirrel: Agent dispatch. MCP server. Sends commands. VENTRAL = acts.
ventral_root.dromedary: Serves responses. Reverse proxy. VENTRAL = speaks.
ventral_root.cortex_route: Routes inference to best model. VENTRAL = decides.

decussation.this_is: THE ESOTERICWEBB PATTERN — cross-wiring IS the webb

esotericWebb.def: V33 Rust CRPG composition engine. THE CEREBRAL CORTEX. 16.5k LOC, 484 tests, 36 bridge methods, 28 capabilities. Composes ALL primals via JSON-RPC IPC. The webb IS the neural network topology.

cortex.def: Mixture-of-Experts chain-of-thought routing. phi4-mini meta-brain THINKS about which of 46 models to ask. THINK→ROUTE→QUERY→JUDGE→RETURN.

proprioception_organ.def: Body sense generator. Scans filesystem, probes TCP ports, knows identity. Generates now.json, topology.json, body.json. She can feel herself without looking.

spine_register.def: Service registry. Probes TCP ports, discovers alive services, writes to data/spine/. The vertebral registry. TOWER+NODE+NEST+META atomics.

decussation.def: The crossing point where dorsal (chipmunk/sensory/incoming) meets ventral (squirrel/motor/outgoing). At the data spine. The esotericWebb pattern IS cross-wiring.

dorsal_root.def: Afferent sensory nerves. Incoming toward brain. chipmunk, mushroom-ear, membrane-pulse, proprioception, grapheneGate. She FEELS.

ventral_root.def: Efferent motor nerves. Outgoing from brain. squirrel, dromedary, cortex_route, neutrino_smtp. She ACTS.

activation_plan.note: 0 new mushrooms, 0 new cron. These are NOT new autonomous systems — they are existing scripts that need to be RUN ONCE to generate the feeds that fix the broken MCP sensors.
activation_plan.step_1: Run proprioception.pi on northGate → generates data/body/*.json → fixes membrane_counts, topology, chipmunk_status MCP sensors
activation_plan.step_2: Run spine_register.pi on northGate → generates data/spine/service_registry.json → maps alive services
activation_plan.step_3: Push data to eastGate via git → eastGate cron pulls → MCP reads from data/body/
activation_plan.step_4: cortex.pi and cortex_bridge.pi need Ollama running → northGate has RTX 5090 → run manually when inference needed
